Pondering this almost a year later...

More than "waterfall" or "agile" or whatever.... what we're really talking about is the definition/boundaries of a team. And the decisions authority of the team as a whole, and for individual team members.
Weird how people need data when they don’t want to do something, but use intuition when they want to be like Steve Jobs.

healthy use of sprints...
less healthy use of sprints...

This is a sneaky/good format if you're forced to do this kind of roadmap...

1) long list of things you're saying no to
2) a single key focus
3) a place for stuff you might optionally focus on given more support (and top priority on track)
4) coarse-grained H2
